project.name: PlateWeave — Reliable 96-Well Designs, Avoid Costly Mistakes
project.summary: A scientist and an AI agent co-design a validated 96-well plate: the human fixes precious samples and approves the exact export while WebMCP gives the agent precise, state-aware spatial operations.
project.ai_usage: Codex planned and implemented the static app, deterministic domain model, WebMCP contracts, tests, and submission artifacts; Codex also acts as the WebMCP client in the demo. Scientific data and metrics are deterministic mock data.
project.codex_usage: Codex shaped the scenario into an executable state machine, implemented and tested nine WebMCP tools, and verified representative tools from the public deployment in the desktop in-app browser.
